mapper.select: SELECT sum(bytes_on_disk) FROM system.parts WHERE table = 'syslog' AND active = 1
SELECT count(DISTINCT partition) FROM system.parts WHERE table = 'syslog' AND active = 1
SELECT ${intervalFunc} as time_bucket, severity, count() as cnt FROM syslog WHERE timestamp >= #{startTime} AND timestamp <= #{endTime} GROUP BY time_bucket, severity ORDER BY time_bucket, severity

SELECT cityHash64(substring(message, 1, 200)) as msg_hash, substring(message, 1, 200) as msg_summary, count() as cnt, min(timestamp) as first_seen, max(timestamp) as last_seen, uniqExact(hostname) as affected_hosts, uniqExact(appname) as affected_apps, any(appname) as service, any(sev) as severity FROM ( SELECT message, timestamp, hostname, appname, severity as sev FROM syslog WHERE timestamp >= #{startTime} AND timestamp <= #{endTime} AND severity IN ('ERROR', 'FATAL', 'CRITICAL', 'error', 'fatal', 'critical') ) as filtered_logs GROUP BY msg_hash, msg_summary HAVING cnt > 1 ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, timestamp, severity, hostname, appname as app_name, message, raw, source_type FROM syslog WHERE timestamp >= #{startTime} AND timestamp <= #{endTime} AND severity IN ('ERROR', 'WARN', 'FATAL', 'CRITICAL', 'error', 'warn', 'fatal', 'critical', 'warning') ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT severity, count() as cnt FROM syslog WHERE timestamp >= #{startTime} AND timestamp <= #{endTime} GROUP BY severity
SELECT sum(bytes_on_disk) as used_bytes, count(DISTINCT partition) as partition_count, sum(rows) as total_rows FROM system.parts WHERE table = 'syslog' AND active = 1
SELECT countIf(query_kind = 'Select') as query_count, countIf(query_kind = 'Insert') as insert_count FROM system.query_log WHERE event_time >= now() - INTERVAL 1 MINUTE
